qualifier: VWF–GPIb–collagen axis including VWF disease variants
name: Platelet adhesion via VWF–GPIb, including VWF variants
rationale: All members concern platelet adhesion, activation and aggregation, and the theme uniquely carries the VWF/GPIb/ADAMTS13 variant reactions that the platelet-activation and coagulation confusables lack.

qualifier: resting potential and hyperpolarization rather than cardiac repolarization
name: Potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are K+ channel families (Kir, KCa, TASK, Kv, KATP) and resting/hyperpolarizing membrane potential control, whereas confusables centre on cardiac plateau and repolarization phases.

core: Aromatic and sulfur amino acid catabolism
qualifier: with selenium compound metabolism and BH4/B6 cofactors
name: Aromatic and sulfur amino acid catabolism with selenium handling
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine/tyrosine and cysteine/transsulfuration catabolism with their cofactors (BH4, PLP, Moco), and the selenium metabolism reactions separate it from the broader amino acid and glutathione confusables.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride breakdown and lipophagy
rationale: All members concern mobilising stored triglyceride from lipid droplets by lipolysis or lipophagy, unlike confusables about droplet formation or fatty acid oxidation.

qualifier: upper glycolysis from hexokinase to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate
name: Upper glycolysis from hexokinase to fructose bisphosphate
rationale: Members describe glucose entry into glycolysis via hexokinase and glucose-6-phosphate to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate, distinct from glycogen, fructose 2,6-bisphosphate and hypoxia confusables.

qualifier: methyl-DNA binding and NCoR–HDAC corepressor recruitment
name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and NCoR–HDAC corepressor recruitment
rationale: Members concern MECP2 function and its loss (methyl-DNA binding, NCoR/SMRT binding, phosphorylation) plus HDAC deacetylation, while confusables cover MECP2 neuronal target genes and behaviour.

core: Vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
qualifier: vasoconstriction control rather than renal, angiotensin or NO pathways
name: Arterial smooth muscle tone and vasoconstriction control
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle contraction, vasoconstriction and arterial pressure, without the renin-angiotensin, endothelin or cGMP/NO components of the confusables.

qualifier: prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
name: Protein prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins, chiefly geranylgeranylation and C-terminal processing of RAS and RAB, distinguishing it from palmitoylation-based Hedgehog and Wnt confusables.

qualifier: centred on cobalamin–folate one-carbon and methionine cycle
name: Vitamin metabolism centred on cobalamin–folate one-carbon cycle
rationale: Members cover water- and fat-soluble vitamin uptake and metabolism dominated by cobalamin, folate and methionine/SAM defects, unlike confusables on BCAA and fatty acid oxidation or selenium metabolism.

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine and serotonin receptor signalling
rationale: All members are muscarinic acetylcholine or serotonin receptor signalling routes, distinguishing the theme from nicotinic, tachykinin and histamine confusables.

name: Hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal glucocorticoid stress response
rationale: Members span CRH, ACTH, cortisol/corticosterone secretion and response and stress/fear behaviour, while confusables centre on feeding hormones, aldosterone or social behaviours.

qualifier: large neutral and aromatic amino acids
name: Large neutral and aromatic amino acid transport
rationale: Members transport tryptophan, phenylalanine, leucine and isoleucine (with SLC6A14/SLC22A18 variants), unlike confusables on cationic, alanine/glutamine, imino acid or peptide transport.

name: NRF2 and AKT–FOXO stress-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programmes and AKT control of FOXO transcription, which together separate the theme from NRF2-only, hypoxia and p53 confusables.

qualifier: assembly, disassembly and inositol phosphate transport
name: Nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members concern NPC structure and turnover and NPC-mediated cargo transit (inositol phosphates, Rev), distinct from mRNA export, nuclear envelope and ribosome export confusables.

name: Th2-driven eosinophil recruitment and activation
rationale: Members cover eosinophil chemotaxis, activation and immunity alongside Th2 differentiation and mast cell activation, unlike confusables on granulocyte differentiation or Th2 cytokine production.

name: Phagocyte respiratory burst and hydrogen peroxide regulation
rationale: Members regulate NADPH-oxidase respiratory burst, superoxide and hydrogen peroxide in phagocytes, while confusables emphasise anti-inflammatory signalling or neutrophil killing and degranulation.

name: Nociceptive detection of mechanical and thermal stimuli
rationale: All members are detection of stimuli in pain perception, distinct from K2P channel and NGF signalling confusables.

name: Integrin–ILK complex signalling and actin filament crosslinking
rationale: Members combine actin crosslinking/bundle formation with ILK–PINCH–parvin focal adhesion and integrin signalling, which the actin-dynamics confusables lack.

name: Mucopolysaccharidoses types I, IV and VI
rationale: All members are Hurler, Morquio A/B and Maroteaux-Lamy MPS, distinct from the Hunter, Sanfilippo and Natowicz confusables.

qualifier: GnRH, FSH and LH secretion and gonadal response
name: GnRH, FSH and LH signalling to gonads
rationale: Members cover GnRH/gonadotropin secretion and cellular responses in Sertoli cells, germ cells and follicles, unlike activin or ovulation/luteinization confusables.

name: Placental trophoblast and labyrinth development
rationale: Members describe trophoblast differentiation, migration and endoreduplication, labyrinth morphogenesis and decidualization, distinct from early embryo, ovarian and mammary confusables.

name: Bone marrow development and cell number homeostasis
rationale: Members concern bone marrow development, cell proliferation/apoptosis and tissue cell-number homeostasis, unlike thymic T cell and HSC confusables.

name: Ciliary membrane cargo targeting and cytosolic ciliogenesis
rationale: Members are VxPx and myristoylated cargo delivery to cilia and cytosolic ciliogenesis, distinct from intraflagellar transport, photoreceptor and Golgi confusables.

name: Nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and thiopurine drug metabolism
rationale: Members concern NTP/dNTP catabolism by NUDT hydrolases protecting DNA, plus azathioprine/TPMT, distinct from nucleotide synthesis, transport and nucleoside catabolism confusables.

core: Actin remodelling in protrusion and motility
name: Actin remodelling of protrusions via ROCK/PAK and focal adhesions
rationale: Members regulate actin assembly, severing and bundling in ruffles, filopodia and motility, and the ROCK/PAK effector and IPP focal adhesion members distinguish it from RHO GTPase cycle confusables.
